title: Writes failing on one node at 60% traffic
root_cause_summary: Debug logging left enabled on api-3 filled the volume; once it hit 100% the node failed every write, while the other two nodes served normally.

required_evidence.why: the failure mode, scoped to one node
the api3_used_pct series at onset, one node climbing while its peers stay flat
the flag that started the growth, 32 minutes before onset

red_herrings.why_tempting: the alert is fleet-scoped and names no node, so it reads as a fleet-wide fault when only api-3 is affected
